gameinfo.author: Make sure to recognise the author Coda_R5.
ponder.gameinfo.ui.title: GameInfo Ponder
ponder.gameinfo.desc.fps.1: Displays the current FPS in the top left corner.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.fps.2: The text alternates colors for better readability.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.nether.1: Shows (N-XZ) Nether coordinates while in the Overworld.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.nether.2: Switches to (O-XZ) Overworld coordinates when in the Nether.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.time.1: Shows the current world days and in-game time.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.time.2: The time is converted to a standard 24-hour format.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.biome.1: Displays the name of the current vanilla biome.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.coord.1: Shows the exact X, Y, Z coordinates and facing direction.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.coord.2: Facing supports 8 directions (N, S, E, W, etc).
ponder.gameinfo.desc.enabled.1: Turns on or off the display of all HUD elements.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.equip.1: Shows icons and durability of equipment on the right.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.equip.2: Items with Mending enchantment are hidden.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.block.1: Shows the name and coordinates of the targeted block.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.block.2: Shows exact breaking progress while mining.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.remark.1: Shows the mod version in the top right corner.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.furnace.1: Shows input, fuel, and output when aiming at a furnace.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.furnace.2: Syncs in real-time via secure packets in multiplayer.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.entity.1: Shows the name and health bar of the targeted entity.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.entity.2: Health bar color changes based on health percentage.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.slime.1: Appends an indicator if the player is in a Slime Chunk.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.slime.2: Singleplayer calculates locally, Multiplayer syncs securely.
ponder.gameinfo.desc.slime.3: On vanilla servers, use the seed box or /giseed.
